_comment: Race-day config for the course model and ghost-runner sim. Defaults are set for a flat, cool late-October marathon (Scotiabank Toronto Waterfront-style). EDIT THESE to match your actual race: set name/date/city, the course's net elevation gain in metres, the typical (normal_temp_c) race-morning temperature, and — closer to the day — the real forecast_temp_c (set it to null to fall back to the normal).
name: Toronto Waterfront Marathon
course_note: Flat lakeshore course — elevation is a near non-factor, so weather is your main external variable.
